Complete series. On your server: S1 6/6

videos.title: His truth vs. her truth
videos.overview: Anurag and Sameera go on a date - a night that will change their lives forever. The truth is tested and the lies are revealed when both have completely different versions of the night. Will truth triumph? Or lies prevail?

videos.title: Old habits die hard!
videos.overview: Pushed to the wall, a desperate Sameera attacks Anurag on social media. As the mystery deepens on what really happened that night, the police unearth a disturbing new lead… that brings Sameera under scrutiny.

videos.title: Lies, lies and more lies!
videos.overview: The case blows wide open when Sameera is accused of crying wolf in the past. Does Sameera have a history of accusing men falsely? Will the new development weaken Sameera's case against Dr. Anurag?

videos.title: The doctor of deceit?
videos.overview: With the cops struggling to find evidence in the case, Sameera takes the matter into her own hands. As Anurag struggles to mend the strained relationship with his son, Sameera goes to Mumbai to dig into his past.

videos.title: Nothing to lose!
videos.overview: The worst kind of betrayal is the one from your loved ones! Already on the edge, a distraught Sameera finds out the shocking truth about her sister and all hell breaks loose. With no one to turn to, Sameera is now dangerously close to playing with fire.

videos.title: The collision course
videos.overview: The secrets are out, the lies are laid bare. With nothing to lose, Sameera and Anurag are now clashing head-on and only one of them will survive this devious Game of Lies!
